13.2 For software and Vendor Technology delivered to Customer on a paid-up basis or embedded in a Deliverable, Vendor grants Customer and its Affiliates a perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free, fully paid licence to use, execute, reproduce, display, perform, modify, create derivative works from, and permit contractors to support that material for Customer's business.</quote>
<parameter name="rationale">Section 13 meets the preferred position in full: 13.1 covers Customer, its Affiliates and contractors acting on their behalf; 13.2 gives paid-up licences that are perpetual and irrevocable; 13.3 allows transfer to an Affiliate or successor under Section 24 and limits revocation or suspension to a material uncured breach after notice and cure. No redline needed.
